2.88.45
Chart.Relationship
Applies to RDL 2011/01
The Chart.Relationship element specifies a relationship to use for correlating data in a Chart with
the data in the containing scope. The Chart.Relationship element is optional and MUST NOT be
specified more than once. If this element is specified, it is of type Relationship. The
Chart.Relationship element MUST NOT be specified if there is no containing scope.
This element is ignored if the data set for the Chart is the same as the dataset for each containing
scope.
Following is the parent element of the Chart.Relationship element.
Parent elements
Chart
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Chart.Relationship element.
 <xsd:element name ="Relationship" type="RelationshipType" minOccurs="0" />
